This article compares the performance of Indikator 4x across national and regional geographical levels in Denmark, based on 2024 data. The analysis reveals a significant regional disparity in the measured outcomes. At the national level, the overall share for Danmark stands at 30.0% (95% CI: 27.0–33.2) [^src1].

When examining the regional breakdown, [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] emerges as the clear leader, achieving the highest performance rate at 40.5% [^src1]. In stark contrast, [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] acts as the trailer, recording the lowest share at just 22.9% [^src1]. This creates a substantial gap of 17.6 percentage points between the highest and lowest performing regions, highlighting a marked geographical spread in the results.

Because the provided data consists of a single dated section, no longitudinal trends or year-over-year improvements can be established. Furthermore, the source data does not specify a predefined target, threshold, or standard for this indicator, meaning it is not possible to determine whether any region has officially met or missed a specific goal. However, the national average serves as a baseline; Region Nordjylland performs notably above the national mean, while Region Sjælland performs significantly below it, making them statistical outliers in opposite directions relative to the country's overall 30.0% rate [^src1].
